obs0_warp6.0: READY_FULL(p): compute warps finished OPERAND(p)+N copy(p); mma_ready full phase
obs0_warp6.2: UPDATE_RELEASED(p): compute warps released mma_done (UPDATE stores issued)
obs0_warp6.3: M_FULL_ALREADY(p): 1 if M(p) had landed when READY(p) was observed

obs1_warp7.1: M_LANDED(p): TMA complete_tx of M(p) (upper bound if flag=1)
obs1_warp7.2: M_ALREADY(p): 1 if M(p) had landed before the observer tested it (stamp is then an upper bound)
obs1_warp7.3: N_RELEASED(p): N slot released after the N copy

obs2_warp4_OBSI_only.0: M_WAIT_BEGIN(p): MMA warp before waiting for M(p)/ready(p)
obs2_warp4_OBSI_only.1: ISSUE_BEGIN(p): after done acquire, before the first gemm

g_obs.K3ObsABND_layout: row index = smid (0..147; rows of SMs without a CTA stay -1); obs 0 = chain A slots (READY, MMA_DONE, UPDATE_RELEASED, M_AT_READY); obs 1 = chain B slots (N_LANDED, -, M_ALREADY_at_N, N_RELEASED); try-count slots unused (-1)

slots.5: status (0 ok, 1 a wait timed out)

schema.units: clock64 = SM-local cycles (14-digit absolute counters, differences within one CTA only); globaltimer = ns
schema.observer_register_budget: warps 6-7 run setmaxregister_decrease(64) in the observer variants (pinned kernel: 32); CTA pool 4x120+2x32+2x64=672 <= 960; compute warps target 120 = launch count

chosen_variant.why: single observer warp (6), both chains in causal order, indexed by %smid, no setmaxnreg change in the idle branch: the only formulation whose CUBIN keeps REG 120 / STACK 16 / LOCAL 0 / 5 LDL-STL identical to B0 (compile matrix 2026-10-25: all two-warp formulations and any idle-branch budget change spilled)
